tiktok.text_safety_zone: top 30% and bottom 25% — middle band is safest for text

twitter.text_safety_zone: bottom third — title and CTA, top 2/3 for visual

gmb.text_safety_zone: full frame — prefer no overlaid text, let the image speak

story.text_safety_zone: top 30% and bottom 25% — middle band is safest for text

education.label: Education & Authority
model_hints: swing golf club mid-motion, TrackMan data overlay, split-screen technique analysis
indoor golf simulator, Paarl, TrackMan launch monitor readings, clean studio lighting
golf instructor demonstrating grip, side-by-side swing comparison, professional setting
negative_prompts: cluttered background, people in background, blurry, low quality, distorted text
outdated equipment, worn golf balls, unprofessional setting, blurry swing
watermark, signature, text overlay unless specified

composition.primary_subject: golfer mid-swing or instructor demonstrating technique
composition.background: clean indoor studio or driving range, Paarl mountains subtly visible through window
composition.lighting: natural daylight from left, soft fill from right, accent spotlight on clubhead
composition.depth_of_field: shallow — subject sharp, background softly blurred

education.example_prompt_fragment: Split-screen golf swing analysis, TrackMan data overlay, indoor Paarl studio, professional photography, F/2.8 shallow depth of field, 35mm prime lens

club-fitting.label: Club Fitting
model_hints: golf club fitting session, fitter with launch monitor screen, client holding new driver
TrackMan screen showing ball flight data, close-up of iron being fitted, precision setting
golf bag with custom fitted clubs, workshop aesthetic, precision tools in frame
negative_prompts: unprofessional workshop, messy environment, broken clubs, low quality
people not relevant to fitting, distracting logos, generic stock photo look
incorrect club sizes, bent shafts, damaged clubheads

composition.primary_subject: fitted golf club or fitting session with data screen
composition.background: Stick fitting studio in Paarl with TrackMan visible, clean precision aesthetic
composition.lighting: dramatic side lighting, slight lens flare from monitor glow, contrasty
composition.depth_of_field: medium — both club and fitting screen in focus

club-fitting.example_prompt_fragment: Golf club fitting session with TrackMan launch monitor, Paarl precision studio, professional product photography, dramatic side lighting, 50mm portrait lens

community.label: Community
model_hints: group of golfers socialising at Stick, warm Winelands evening light
golf community event, people laughing with clubs, outdoor course backdrop
golfer high-fiving instructor after lesson, celebration moment, authentic candid
negative_prompts: sad expressions, people looking at camera directly, posed group photo
crowded messy backgrounds, cigarette smoke, outdated facilities
people alone looking lonely, overly commercial, stock photo aesthetic

composition.primary_subject: people connecting over golf — genuine, candid-feeling moments
composition.background: Stick studio or a nearby Winelands golf course, warm evening golden hour
composition.lighting: golden hour warm light, natural and flattering, slight lens flare
composition.depth_of_field: shallow — subjects sharp, bokeh lights in background

community.example_prompt_fragment: Golf community social event, Winelands golden hour, genuine celebration moment, candid documentary photography, warm color grading, 35mm street photography lens

events.label: Events & Offers
model_hints: Stick event banner in foreground, Paarl mountain backdrop, professional event photography
golfer celebrating a win with new fitted clubs, premium offer framing
promotional display at Stick, trackman data visible, exclusive offer visual
negative_prompts: outdated promotional materials, low-res graphics, clip art
empty venue, sad lonely atmosphere, wrong brand colors
other brand logos prominent, competitor branding, generic stock look

composition.primary_subject: event atmosphere or promotional offer with clear call-to-action
